description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Mr. M. H. G. Bandara as an Additional Secretary, w.e.f. 16.01.2019
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. M. H. G. Bandara) to a government position (Additional Secretary to the President). It includes the person's name and title but does not provide any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or duties associated with the position. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
